what: Several photos stacked in one cell and a final video start closed from the bottom up (clip-path inset 100% from the bottom). From .4s later they open upward one at a time at .5s intervals, each over .8s power1.out. Once the last one is open, the earlier ones vanish in .5s and only the last one (the video) remains. This is the opening of the small hero window.

options.each: Seconds a slide takes to open, default .8
options.gap: Gap between sheets (seconds), default .5 — 0 means all at once
options.fade: Length for the front sheet to vanish after fully opening (seconds), default .5 — 0 means immediately
options.ease: Curve (GSAP name or in the form ”0.25,1,0.5,1”), default power1.out
options.start: load (default) shows right after loading, otherwise once when visible at the ScrollTrigger start (e.g. top 80%)
options.[data-fx-part=shot]: Sections that open stacked (children) — they open in document order and the last section stays. Needs two or more

from.where: index.html .tr-mv__shot ×5 + .tr-mv__clip (vertical video window in the Hero) — the clip-path line of the original opening timeline (five photos → video)

note: In the original, this opening sits in the middle of the opening timeline (while the video window descends from 50% above over 3.6s). This part extracts only the opening. It is a device that makes users wait long, so for screens opened often, like an app, use gap: 0; each: reduce to .4 when used
